title: Signal Foundry
description:
REAWAKEN A DERELICT DEEP-SPACE REFINERYAdrift on the edge of a dead system, Station 09 still hums on backup power. Sweep your hover-laser across rich ore veins, fracture armored Mega-Cores into multi-resource loot fountains, route automated cargo drones, balance reactor heat on the razor's edge, and chart a multi-sector constellation back to the Source of the Signal.

Signal Foundry blends tactile moment-to-moment satisfaction with deep multi-layer buildcraft — built equally for active combo chasing and chill second-monitor Zen play.⚡ TACTILE JUICE & EXPLOSIVE JACKPOTS• Hover-Laser Plasma Cutter & Hold-to-Work: Sweep your cursor over deposits to slice rock automatically with progressive pixel fracture cracks, sparks, and rising pentatonic chimes — zero mindless clicking required.

• Armored Mega-Core Boss Veins: Every 5th tier spawns a high-density Mega-Core that shatters into a staggered Loot Fountain of Ore, Crystals, Echoes, and Frenzy charge.

• Overlapping Fever Jackpots: Catch drifting Sky Comets or Vent Reactor Heat during Foundry Frenzy (×3.0) to ignite Supercritical Overload (×6.0) and Hypernova Resonance (×9.0) with visible synergy cascades.
✦ DEEP BUILDCRAFT & MULTI-LAYER PRESTIGE• Roguelike Shift Augments: Draft 1-of-3 rule-bending perks from 18 Shift Augments every run, complete with live Synergy Tags and free rerolls.

• Interactive Core Constellation Skill Tree: Chart 16 permanent nodes across 4 illuminated star branches with fog-of-war discovery and Buy ×1 / ×5 / Max.

• 10 Station Doctrines & Mk5 Module Specializations: Mix active Doctrines and choose mutually exclusive Branch A / B forks at Mk5 on all 6 core modules, alongside Mk5/Mk10/Mk15 ×2 Overhaul Spikes.

• Reactor Thermal Edge & Overdrive: Ride the 75%–105% Hot Zone for up to ×3.0 Forge output, route surplus wattage across 4 Overdrive buses, or dump heat with VENT! for instant Echoes and Frenzy.

• 6 Distinct Deep Sectors & Sister-Foundry Network: Jump across 6 custom pixel-art biomes (each with unique physics and active twists), awaken 6 permanent autonomous Sister Foundries, and clear 6 Calibration Trials.
🌌 BUILT FOR ACTIVE PLAY OR SECOND-MONITOR CHILL• 3-Mode Power-Safe Automation: Hand off scanning, logistics, fabrication, and recalibration to smart Logistics AI that never brownouts your reactor.

• Cozy Zen Mode (Z) & 19-Track OST: Collapse the sidebars into a full-bleed pixel foundry + lo-fi retro music deck companion, backed by full offline progress.

• 54 Steam Achievements & Cloud Saves: Complete Edition — zero microtransactions, zero paywalls, full Steam Cloud sync.
description_short: A cozy idle game about reviving an abandoned deep-space refinery. Get the scanner running, dig up ore, build the machines that process it, and let your drones run the place while you're away. Two prestige layers, 54 achievements, a 19-track soundtrack, and no microtransactions, ever.
